focus: Metric/imperial preference persistence, unknown raw values, and preserving scene precision when switching display units; formatter internals excluded.

checks.result: Settings and Studio use the same StudioPreferences.unitsKey and shared defaults instance, with metric as the absent-key default. The Settings binding setter writes only unitsRaw.

PlanUnits(rawValue:) failure falls back to metric. Picker selection, picker accessibility value, and Studio displayUnits all use that same helper, keeping a valid Meters selection and consistent display without rewriting scene coordinates.

Unit switching writes only the separate AppStorage preference. Studio scene remains a separate State value; unit consumption in StudioView is read-only display/export conversion. The reviewed unit path has no scene reassignment, rounding write-back, unit-change history entry, or unit-change observer.

DEBUG UI testing uses a UUID-named UserDefaults suite; makeApp supplies one UUID in the application's launch environment, supporting suite reuse when that same application object relaunches. Production path uses standard defaults.

testSettingsFeet3DFitAndSimulatorARManualFallback asserts initial Meters, selection of Feet, Studio header propagation, same-process Settings reopening retention, and manual-room Width in feet. It does not exercise units preference across process relaunch, Feet-to-Meters round-trip, injected unknown raw units, or exact scene equality before/after toggles.
Read AGENTS and mandatory startup documents plus m02-m03-code-v2. M03 remains active in the reviewed state. This report supplies bounded source-review evidence only and does not promote a gate.
